subject.title: ACP parent session stuck until refresh when yielded waiting for child completion

question: Should OpenClaw solve yielded-parent completion as one cross-runtime wake contract, or keep landing narrow ACP/native/give-up fixes independently?
rationale: The source-level bug is real, but the permanent fix defines core session wake semantics across ACP, native subagents, heartbeat-off deployments, and failure delivery; that behavior boundary needs maintainer intent before another broad repair lane starts.

options.title: Define one wake contract
options.body: Use the open narrow PRs only if they align with a single durable yielded-parent wake/resume invariant that covers successful, blocked, failed, and heartbeat-disabled completion paths.

options.title: Land narrow slices only
options.body: Continue reviewing PRs like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95776 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95080 as scoped mitigations while keeping this issue open as the umbrella.

options.title: Split by runtime
options.body: Declare separate canonical trackers for ACP, native subagents, and announce give-up behavior, then demote this issue to a historical umbrella once each tracker is linked.

recommendation.title: Define one wake contract
recommendation.body: Use the open narrow PRs only if they align with a single durable yielded-parent wake/resume invariant that covers successful, blocked, failed, and heartbeat-disabled completion paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans the subagent announce, task delivery, and ACP/task surfaces needed for a cross-runtime wake contract.
